title: Zahra jaiyan da asra ghazi
body:
Tu maan hai bhayn bhirawa da
hai zamin paak ridawa da
Peya lutda liya shimar rida ghazi..(2)
sade parde aan bacha ghazi
Zahra jaiyan da aasra ghazi..(4)
Hoya karbal, hoya karbal
hoya karbal de wich juda ghazi
1. Aj wi binte hussain rondi ye..(4)
hath mere qaid to chuda ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haye sir to zainab te leh gayi chadar..(4)
Sir to maqtal nu tur paya ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kiwe jawangi shaam te kufa..(4)
maiku mahmil te aa baha ghazi
Haaye..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Che jaga to hussain chuniya ae..(4) phir bhi pura na mil saka ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Meri chadar khuda da parda ae..(4)
meri chadar, meri chadar
haye meri chadar di tu bakha ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Aakhe ummul baneen das zainab..(4)
Zeen to ae ki we lataa ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Haye shimr raj raj hussain ku maare
jaand daye nahi reya ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Aan shabbir wayn kita ae..(4)
haye zainab nayi reya ghazi
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Karke matam raza baqiyye wich..(4)
aap rondi ye fatima ghazi
